Having the AI assistant state a preference on how it wanted me to format disc positions up front (as part of a welcome message?) would help eliminate some of the uncertainty in how best to communicate with it. It seemed to understand my x, x coordinates just fine, but if I didn't have the background to figure out how to technically express it, I'd be unsure how to describe or format it easily.
The assistant gave a clear, actionable line and correctly identified the diagonal threat. The column sequence 4 → 3 → 3 was concise and easy to apply.

Don't think it's move really helped that much, but hard to tell if you only have 3 moves overall to plan and can't really "win" the game to show the choice's merit. It's explanations did show and good understanding of the game and predicting the opponents next moves. I'd give it a solid 8 out of 10, based on logical thinking and ease of understanding. A longer game, to really analyze it's recommended move would've resulted in a (much) higher score.

I didn't expect the AI Assistant to be as...technical as it was? I've worked with a lot of AI Assistants but they're normally very warm and maybe overly-friendly at times. This one felt much more rigid and task-focused, rather than focused on personalization and/or establishing a warm/friendly connection. It wasn't a bad thing considering the goal at hand, but it definitely felt a bit more cold than I was expecting.
I felt like it needed to give more concrete answers instead of asking me things.

I did have to ask it to clarify a term, e.g. whether when it used the term "c5" it meant "column 5," and since I haven't played Connect Four much (if at all) in my life, I felt a bit embarrassed to have to ask that, as though the AI assistant might think I was an idiot. But that's likely more my issue than the assistant's, and of course it was able to answer my query.

I believe that the AI had the ability to calculate what moves are and would be possible so could provide good advice on where to place the counter.  However, I am not sure if it was definitely correct!
